xpath.p: Check your network connection and come back here. JAKH ERP will load when you are back online.

main.p: Use the single Modules column or the dashboard to open your work. CRM, estimating, projects, commercial, procurement, finance, Quality/HSE and document control are available together according to your permissions. Reports and My Approvals are always in the same navigation.
Contact your platform owner for access, process configuration, training or support. Do not send passwords or private invitation links.

section.p: Explore the synthetic construction journey and open the demo records your role can access. Changes remain available for your next visit.

main.p: Use Administration to manage authorized users, company configuration and permissions. Email, SMS, enrichment, external accounts and other integrations require an explicitly approved provider and tested configuration. Do not assume a bundled option is configured or included in your subscription.
Financial reports use posted records. Operational dashboards show only records you are authorized to access. Review the basis, company, currency and selected period before using a total.

This staging release includes the foundation and connected contracting workflows. An optional module or setting does not prove that its functionality or licensing is included. Review requirements and acceptance evidence before enabling extensions.

This platform includes open-source components. Their original licenses, copyright notices and source provenance are retained in the distributed source package. Obtain the complete source and notices from your platform owner.
Probability estimates use recorded lead outcomes and configured attributes. They are estimates, not promises. Review the available history and adjust a manual probability when justified.
Follow the completed reference journey, then practise with the pending work. Every record opens in the native JAKH ERP form with your normal permissions.

div.p: Select only the synthetic demo company. Use the single Modules column for all work and the language selector for English or Arabic. Keep this guide open while you follow its record links.

The guide shows only records your role can read. A missing link can mean restricted access, an unavailable snapshot or a record changed since preparation. Ask the platform owner for the appropriate role; do not share accounts.
A retained report snapshot may expire. Use Reports to create a new snapshot when required.

main.p: No retained demo records are available to your current role. Ask the platform owner to review access or prepare the dataset.

section.p: This demo is retained. Closing the browser, signing out or restarting the application does not reset your changes. There is no automatic deletion or reset.

To start again, ask the platform owner to prepare a separate synthetic dataset or restore a matched database and filestore backup. Keep the existing demonstration history until the owner explicitly approves its replacement.
Restoring application source alone does not undo database changes.

All scenario data is synthetic. It is for training and review, not production, compliance evidence or statutory localization acceptance. No external API keys, live Primavera service, banking connection or real payment is required.
Report schedules and external delivery remain disabled unless separately reviewed and configured. The native workflow still enforces approval roles and record access.
